subject: SIG follow-up: Request for rotation proofset + HSM attestation and in-transit controls
messages:
From: Sam Holt <sam.holt@infracert.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: alice.kim@acme-security.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request: KMS/HSM rotation evidence + transit controls

Hi Soojin,

We are working through the SIG questionnaire for Acme Corp and need a handful of artifacts to validate your encryption and key-management controls. Can you provide the following artifacts or point us to a shared folder?

- HSM vendor attestation (FIPS/PP / vendor statement) covering your use of external HSMs for Private deployments
- KMS rotation logs (last 12 months) — preferably CSV export with key_id, rotation_timestamp, rotated_by, action_type
- Example key lifecycle proof for one production key (key ID or alias + pre/post rotation hashes)
- Diagram of envelope encryption flow (how data keys are generated, wrapped, and stored)
- TLS in-transit cipher suite matrix and certificate rotation cadence

We can accept redacted exports where necessary. Ideally we’d like these by EOD Thursday (2026-07-30).

Thanks,
Sam
Infracert Audit Team

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Holt <sam.holt@infracert.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request: KMS/HSM rotation evidence + transit controls

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear list.

We can provide the HSM attestation and a rotation log export. A couple of clarifying points before we gather artifacts:
- Do you need full, unredacted key IDs or will hashed identifiers suffice? We typically provide SHA256 hashes of key IDs for external auditors.
- For "production key" example: should we pick a hosted-platform-managed key or a customer-managed key from a Dedicated/Private deployment?

Tentative plan/timeline (will confirm by EOD today):
- Provide HSM attestation PDF (redwood-hsm-attestation-2025.pdf)
- Exported rotation CSV for 2025-07 through 2026-07 (redacted)
- Envelope encryption diagram and TLS cipher suite matrix

Looping in Neha (Security) to prepare the exports and Marcus (Customer Success) for context on Acme’s environment.

Best,
Soojin
Soosin (Soojin) Lee
Manager, Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: sam.holt@infracert.com, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request: KMS/HSM rotation evidence + transit controls

Hi all — attaching the artifacts we can share for SIG review. Notes included inline.

Attachments: 1) redwood-hsm-attestation-2025.pdf (attestation from Thales for Private/HSM integration)
2) kms-rotation-log-202507-202607.csv (export; key_id column hashed with SHA256; timezone UTC)
3) envelope-encryption-arch-v2.png (PNG, internal diagram)
4) tls-cipher-suite-matrix.txt (list of supported ciphers & rotation cadence)

Quick clarifications:
- Hosted API: platform-managed keys live in AWS KMS (multi-tenant logical separation). Platform master keys are rotated annually; usage (data) keys are rotated per workload by policy.
- Dedicated/Private: we support customer-provided KMS and HSMs. For private deployments where an HSM is used, the HSM vendor (Thales) provides an attestation; that attestation is attached.
- Rotation policy: default platform CMKs rotated once every 365 days; application/data key rotation depends on workload (commonly every 90 days for stricter customers). Rotation actions are logged in the CSV (action_type = Rotate/Create/Disable).
- On example proof: the CSV includes a sampled record for alias "acme-prod-data-key" (key hash shown) — raw key material is never exported.

Redaction note: we replaced full key IDs with SHA256(key_id) to preserve confidentiality while allowing you to match before/after values for rotation proofs. If you require a live-compare for a single key, we can coordinate an ephemeral HMAC-based reveal under an NDA.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sam Holt <sam.holt@infracert.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, alice.kim@acme-security.com
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request: KMS/HSM rotation evidence + transit controls

Thanks, Neha — that looks mostly good. A couple follow-ups:

1) For the sampled record: please confirm the exact hash algorithm used (SHA256) and provide the input format (utf-8 of key alias or full key UUID). We need deterministic hashing to match our extraction.
2) Can you provide the pre/post rotation digest values for one of the sampled keys (we only need the wrapped-key digest, not the raw DEK) or provide a signed statement that identity changes correspond to rotation timestamps?
3) TLS: please confirm minimum TLS version supported for client-server (we require TLS1.2+), and provide your cert rotation cadence for public certs and mTLS certs if applicable.

If possible, we’d prefer the single-key pre/post digest by EOD Monday (2026-08-02).

Sam

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Holt <sam.holt@infracert.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request: KMS/HSM rotation evidence + transit controls

Sam — quick answers and the requested single-key artifact (redacted) are in the shared drive link below.

- Hash algorithm: SHA256 over the key UUID (lowercase hex string) encoded as UTF-8. We included the hashing script and sample values in the drive folder so you can validate reproducibility.
- Single-key proof: we exported the wrapped-key digest before and after rotation for alias acme-prod-data-key (both digests are included; note these are wrapped-key HMACs produced by the KMS; raw DEKs never leave the KMS). The CSV row for that alias is labelled with the hashed key_uuid; the before/after digest columns are present.
- TLS: minimum supported TLS version is 1.2; recommended is 1.3 for all new deployments. Public certs rotated every 90 days via our cert automation; mTLS certificate rotation for private deployments is customer-configurable but we recommend 90-day rotation.

Shared folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Acme-SIG-KMS-evidence-2026
DocuSign link for attestation acknowledgement (if needed): https://www.docusign.com/envelope/status/ABC123XYZ

If you need an in-person HSM attestation or unredacted artifact, we’ll need a signed NDA and a pre-specified scope.

Thanks,
Neha
